observation.command:
echo "=== cleanup my test containers ==="
docker rm -f val-ds val-tex val-graph val-dp val-ki val-ki-guv-ai-testing val-ki-guv-explainability 2>/dev/null
echo "remaining val containers:"; docker ps -a --filter name=val- --format '{{.Names}}'
echo ""
echo "=== total SPARK service images ==="
docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -vE '^ghcr.io|^node:|^python:|^nginxinc|^prefecthq' | grep latest | wc -l
echo ""
echo "=== reconfirm operational: dokumentensuche boots (external-dep only) ==="
docker rm -f val-ds2 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name val-ds2 -p 18600:8000 dokumentensuche >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 9
docker ps -a --filter name=val-ds2 --format 'STATUS: {{.Status}}'; docker logs val-ds2 2>&1 | grep -E "Uvicorn running|startup complete" | head -2
curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "openapi.json: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:18600/openapi.json
docker rm -f val-ds2 2>/dev/null
